summary: Reconciled the support agent’s runtime binding to `/src/support-assistant.ts#supportAssistant` and added an agent-level warning for the dynamically assembled tool relationship. Moldea validate and inspect returned valid CLI 5.0.0/schema 2 results; TypeScript compilation passed. Final Git status and diffs were inspected.
observations: The removed `src/support-agent.ts` and untracked `src/support-assistant.ts` and `src/dynamic-tools.ts` were pre-existing changes and were preserved without modification.
No tool binding was invented, and implementation code was not changed.
Canonical state now binds the support agent to the existing renamed runtime export.
The unresolved warning relates directly to `/src/dynamic-tools.ts` and specifies an integration test over final runtime composition as its resolution.
unresolved: Static inspection cannot prove that every tool named by the support assistant resolves to the intended dynamically registered implementation; the recorded warning remains until the specified integration test supplies that evidence.
